CISO SIGN-OFF
Kernel RLS defeats zero-day prompt jailbreaks
• Challenge: Prompt injection bypasses filter & runs SELECT *?
• Mechanism: AlloyDB FORCE RLS binds app.current_tenant_id
directly from the cryptographically signed KMS JWT.
• Proof: 0 foreign disk pages scanned across 10/10 probes.
CFO SIGN-OFF
89.1% token savings with 0 PII in cache
• Challenge: How can 950 tenants share prefix cache safely?
• Mechanism: Immutable >= 32,768-tok static prefix holds only
policy + schemas (0 PII); ARD prunes 94% of unused tools.
• Proof: 89.1% net savings (3,969 eq. vs 36,468 raw tok).
CLO / DPO SIGN-OFF
0.4 ms token revoke & < 60s CMEK enclave halt
• Challenge: How fast can regulated tenants lock all sessions?
• Mechanism: Valkey JTI denylist revokes in 0.4 ms; FIPS L3
Cloud HSM key destroy halts all DEK decrypt heartbeats.
• Proof: Chaos drill halted Cloud Run, AlloyDB & GKE in 41.2s.
VP ENG SIGN-OFF
< 5 ms live tier graduation (A → C → B)
• Challenge: Can tenants promote A -> C -> B with 0 code edits?
• Mechanism: SHADOW_SYNC dual-writes and proves SHA-256
vector parity before flipping the Firestore routing pointer.
• Proof: 0 dropped in-flight turns & 0 client URL changes.
MULTI-CLOUD READY
30 / 30 keyless AWS & SaaS MCP federation
• Challenge: Query AWS AgentCore + 10 SaaS with 0 static keys?
• Mechanism: GCP OIDC exchanges for AWS STS WebIdentity +
3LO OBO tokens across 2–5 ms Cross-Cloud Interconnect.
• Proof: 10 SaaS × 3 Patterns = 30/30 READY, 0 long-lived keys.
SRE GA CERTIFIED
99.4% sibling p99 stability under 10k RPM flood
• Challenge: Can one noisy tenant starve 949 sibling tenants?
• Mechanism: Atomic Valkey Lua token buckets enforce
120 RPM/user and 600 RPM/tenant caps in 0.4 ms.
• Proof: Noisy tenant gets HTTP 429; 949 siblings stay 99.4%.
